Action

Stove & pan calibration

From the manual: maximum power

The rating is electrical input (or fuel input for gas). Transfer is an editable technology-based estimate, not a measurement. Use the normal maximum, excluding Boost. Electric plate types share a rough default; actual pan size and contact matter.

Approximate starting values informed by NYSERDA and ENERGY STAR. Technology currently changes the efficiency estimate; burner heat distribution and response time remain simplified.

Optional: time to boil 1 litre

Use your frying pan on the same cooking zone, without a lid. Start with 1 litre of water and the pan at the same temperature. Use the highest numbered setting, without Boost, with other zones off. Time from switching on until sustained boiling; then switch off.

20 °C is an assumption for room-temperature water, not cold tap water. Boiling is assumed at 100 °C (near sea level).

Includes heating the selected pan and estimated convection and radiation losses. Evaporation and hob warm-up are not resolved. This is an approximate effective input, not the electrical rating. The cooking model still uses a 28 cm pan. One measurement cannot identify the lower settings or heat losses independently.

Saved in this browser for the selected pan preset. Changing pan uses that pan's saved profile, or model defaults. Cooking actions keep their relative settings.
